sections.html: Are you looking for a sign from the angelic realm? Are you seeking more connection with the spirit world? Do you need more peace and positive vibes in your life? The stone of guardian angels, the Angelite crystal is a gentle, healing stone that aligns your spirit with the divine. If any of these scenarios relate to you, then Angelite is the crystal you need.

The Angelite meaning is known as a peaceful crystal that embodies the gentle vibrations of your guardian angels. Working with the Angelite crystal infuses your spirit with serenity and positivity. It will heighten your awareness of the invisible world and remind you that angels are all around you. Even just gazing at its heavenly blue hues invokes connection with the celestial realm. When you feel its divine energies of support, the Angelite meaning acts as a direct line between you and the angelic realm.

The Angelite stone is a relatively new crystal, discovered in Peru in 1987. It is also sometimes referred to as Blue Anhydrite. This name comes from the Greek word, anhydrous, meaning, “without water.” That is a reference to the stone’s unique physical property, as a dehydrated gypsum. The Angelite crystal only develops in areas where gypsum crystals once had contact with water. Over millions of years, the water evaporates and the gypsum crystals get compressed, resulting in the formation of Angelite.

The Angelite meaning comes from its light blue, ethereal color and the belief that this crystal can enhance one’s connection with angels or the divine realm.

sections.t: How to use your Angelite properties to awaken your spirit
sections.html:
An effective way to align yourself with the gentle, angelic frequencies of the Angelite stone meaning is by creating a crystal program that includes wearing it, carrying it, and placing it in your environment. 

Wear

Infuse your aura with the uplifting energy of the Angelite crystal when you wear a piece of jewelry made with this peaceful stone of angels. As you go about your day, the energy of the Angelite meaning will give you constant access to your guardian angels. 

Carry

Support your intent of deeper communication with your inner spiritual guide by carrying an Angelite stone in your purse or pocket. Whenever you need the support of your guardian angel, hold onto the crystal to align yourself with the tranquil frequencies of the Angelite healing properties.

Place

Place an Angelite stone anywhere you need peaceful and tranquil vibes such as your healing sanctuary or bedroom. Let the stone be a reminder to open yourself up to signs from the divine.

Angelite crystal intention for enhancing your spiritual connection: I am surrounded by the supportive and gentle energy of guardian angels.

sections.t: Clear and activate the frequencies of the Angelite meaning
sections.html:
To get the most out of working with the Angelite uses, an important step is to clear the stone of any previous programming or old energy. This allows the properties of the Angelite meaning to work towards your spiritual goals with the highest potential. When the Angelite crystal is cleared and charged with new, vibrant energy, it will be open and receptive to supporting your intention for communicating with your inner spirit guides. 

Selenite

Restore the frequencies of the Angelite meaning to its brightest form with a Selenite charging plate, a wonderful energy clearing tool as well as an elegant display for your crystal collection. Known for its purifying and amplifying properties, Selenite infuses pure white light into everything it comes into contact with, making it the only crystal that doesn’t need to be charged or cleansed. Place your Angelite crystal on Selenite for at least 4 hours or more.  

Sacred Smoke

When you burn the sacred smoke of Sage and Palo Santo, it does more than fill your space with sweet and earthy aromas. Along with grounding effects, sacred smoke also quickly carries away any old, stagnant energy from both your environment and crystals. To clear and activate your Angelite crystal, fully immerse the stone in smoke for 30 seconds or until its energy seems bright and vibrant.
